commands.title: Read device information
commands.description: Reads Proxmark3 client, firmware and hardware information.

commands.title: Search for HF / NFC cards
commands.description: Looks for nearby 13.56 MHz RFID/NFC cards and prints safe identification details.
commands.notes: Good first command for HF/NFC cards.

commands.title: Read ISO14443-A card information
commands.description: Reads public ISO14443-A details such as UID, ATQA, SAK and protocol hints.

commands.title: Read MIFARE Classic information
commands.description: Reads public MIFARE Classic metadata and card capability hints without writing data.
commands.notes: Does not read protected sector contents without valid keys.

commands.title: Read MIFARE Ultralight / NTAG information
commands.description: Reads public Ultralight/NTAG information and memory/capability hints.
commands.notes: Safe read-only command for Type 2 style tags.

commands.title: Search for LF tags
commands.description: Looks for low-frequency RFID tags and prints detected format/ID details when decoded.
commands.notes: Good first command for LF key fobs and access tags.

commands.title: Read HID Prox tag
commands.description: Attempts to read HID Prox low-frequency credentials.
commands.notes: Read-only, but credential data may be sensitive.

commands.title: Detect T55xx chipset
commands.description: Checks whether a writable T55xx-style LF chip is present.

commands.title: Recover known MIFARE Classic keys and create backup files
commands.description: Attempts authorised MIFARE Classic key recovery and can create dump/key backup files.
commands.notes: Use only for cards you own or are authorised to test.

commands.title: Read MIFARE Classic sector with authorised key
commands.description: Reads a MIFARE Classic sector when the user has a valid authorised key.
commands.notes: Keys and output may be sensitive; Electron masks key material where possible.

commands.title: Write MIFARE Classic block
commands.description: Writes data to a MIFARE Classic block.
commands.notes: Blocked by Electron safety rules unless a future explicit safe workflow permits it.
